name: Wizard
label: Wizard
description: A task in steps: the stepper, the step under its heading, and Back and Continue with a running summary.

props.name: step
props.description: The index of the step shown, for a controlled wizard. Leave it undefined to let the wizard keep its own, seeded from `defaultStep`.

props.name: defaultStep
props.description: The step shown on first render when the wizard is uncontrolled. Defaults to 0.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: Fires with the index of the step the reader moves to, by Back, Continue or a completed step in the stepper.

props.name: onFinish
props.description: Called when the reader presses the last step's finish button.

props.name: canAdvance
props.description: Whether the reader can move on from the step shown: false holds Continue and Finish, while the step's own fields say what is missing. Defaults to true.

props.name: summary
props.description: A running figure at the start of the footer, kept in view as the steps change: a total, a count of what is chosen.

props.name: allowStepClick
props.description: Lets the reader go back to a completed step from the stepper. Defaults to true.

props.name: backLabel
props.description: The back button's text. Defaults to "Back".

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: The next button's text. Defaults to "Continue".

props.name: finishLabel
props.description: The last step's button text. Defaults to "Finish".

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the stepper's step numbers are written in. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The step heading's place in the outline. Defaults to 2, a section of a page.

keys.note: Back, Continue and Finish are native buttons, as are the stepper’s completed steps, and focus moves to each step’s heading.

alternatives.name: Stepper
alternatives.when: only the progress is needed and the host lays out the steps and their buttons
